turns.question: How long does your morning stiffness last each day? Have you had any measured fevers or noticed any rash?

assessment.summary: 58-year-old man with progressive symmetric polyarthritis (wrists, fingers, elbows, shoulders, knees, ankles, feet) evolving over 2 months, preceded by sicca symptoms and joint pain at 4 months, and chills at 7 months. Associated fatigue, weight loss, and evening chills. The symmetric small- and large-joint involvement with systemic features and sicca raises differential including autoimmune arthritis (RA, Sjögren's), adult-onset Still's disease, infection, or malignancy. Morning stiffness duration and fever/rash pattern would help narrow the differential.
assessment.working: Progressive symmetric polyarthritis with systemic features and sicca; aetiology undetermined pending further characterisation of inflammatory pattern and systemic features.
